phase: P07 (batch 1: order creation, cancellation and stock return)
scope: All 48 order-management routes and their guards
Storefront and admin callers of order creation
reviewed_without_change: Order status, totals, mark-paid, mark-fulfilled, shipments, events and status-history writes are staff-only; backorder and preorder writes admin-only.
Order reads (order, items, addresses, shipments, status history) check ownership in the service (staff bypass).
Order creation prices items from the catalog on the server.
Order tracking: by tracking number returns no addresses; by order number requires the order's email; rate limited.

findings.problem: Customers could cancel orders that were already paid or being processed. Cancellation issues no refund, so the customer was left without goods or money, and staff were not involved.
findings.change: Customers may cancel only unpaid orders (created, pending, confirmed); paid orders are refused with a message to contact customer service, who can cancel them (and handle the refund).
findings.verification: order E2E: baseline (with the old rules) customer cancellation of a paid order succeeded; fixed refused with 422 and the order stays paid; customer can still cancel an unpaid order; staff can cancel the paid one.

findings.file: order-management.service.ts cancelOrder; inventory stock-management.service.ts; order external-services port
findings.problem: Cancelling an order tried to release a stock reservation, but checkout takes stock off the shelf (P06-05) and reserves nothing, so the release failed silently and a cancelled order's stock never returned to sale.
findings.change: Cancellation returns exactly the stock the order took, from the inventory ledger (minus anything already returned), as 'return' ledger entries referencing the order, in one transaction; orders that only reserved stock (manual orders) still have their reservation released.
findings.verification: E2E: baseline stock stayed 2 units short (98 vs 100) after cancelling; fixed back to 100 with ledger [order -2, return +2].

findings.problem: POST /orders accepted unauthenticated requests: anyone could create unpaid orders (each raising staff notifications and reserving stock) and attach them to any guest token supplied in the body. No storefront or admin screen uses it; storefront orders come from checkout.
findings.change: Direct order creation requires ADMIN or CUSTOMER_SERVICE (manual/phone orders); the order belongs to the customer named by customerId, never to the staff member.
findings.verification: E2E: baseline anonymous request passed authorisation (400 on validation); fixed anonymous 401, customer 403, staff 201 with the order owned by the customer.

tests.new: order E2E creation and cancellation policy (3)
tests.updated: order E2E lifecycle and deletion-policy helpers create orders as staff for the customer
tests.baseline: With the old service, routes and port: 3 of 3 new cases failed.
tests.database_suites: All E2E and integration suites: 140 tests in 42 files pass
tests.final: 1511 unit tests in 117 files; root/tooling tsc; 7/7 workspace type-checks; API client regenerated (customerId) and drift check passes

follow_ups: Cancelling or refunding a paid order changes the order status only; the Stripe refund is not issued (P08 refund flow).
Manually created orders reserve stock but marking them paid or fulfilled never converts the reservation into a deduction.
Order status can be set to refunded by staff through PATCH /orders/:id/status without any payment refund.
